headline: Posture is how you carry yourself—your default physical position affects health and presence
universal_truth: How you hold yourself shapes how you feel and how others perceive you; form affects function
fun_facts: Slouching can reduce lung capacity by up to 30%
Poor posture can compress internal organs and affect digestion
Standing up straight has been shown to increase confidence and testosterone levels
discussion_questions: How do you hold yourself when you're confident versus uncertain?
What does your default posture say about you?
How might changing your posture change your experience?

hook.title: Welcome
hook.script: Slouch, and you feel smaller, weaker, less confident. Stand tall, and you feel present, capable, ready. Posture isn't just body position—it's physical state affecting mental state. How you hold yourself shapes how you feel.

options.text: I want to learn something new
options.response: Perfect. Curiosity is the first step to understanding. Let's explore this together.
That curiosity is exactly what we need. Let's dive in and discover something amazing.

cliff.title: The Question
cliff.script: We often think posture is just about appearance. But it affects much more. What does how you carry yourself actually influence?

options.text: Posture affects everything—breathing, digestion, pain, energy, mood, and how others perceive you; physical form influences function throughout the system
options.response: Yes. Compress your chest, you breathe less. Hunch your shoulders, tension builds. Posture isn't cosmetic—it's functional. How you hold yourself affects how your body works.

options.text: Posture is mostly about looking good
options.response: Appearance matters, but the functional effects go much deeper—breathing, digestion, pain...

q1.title: Physical Function
q1.script: Posture affects breathing, circulation, digestion, and muscle tension. Aligned posture lets systems work optimally. Misaligned posture creates strain, restriction, and dysfunction.
q1.prompt: What's your first impression of "Physical Function"?

options.text: This confirms what I already knew
options.response: Great foundation! Now let's build on that knowledge with something you might not expect...
Perfect starting point! This insight will connect to even more surprising facts ahead.

q2.title: Psychological Effect
q2.script: How you hold your body affects how you feel. Power poses increase confidence. Slouching decreases mood. It's bidirectional—body affects mind as much as mind affects body.
q2.prompt: How does this connect to what you already know?

options.response: Exactly. These connections are how knowledge becomes understanding.

options.text: I need to think about this more
options.response: That's a good instinct. Deep understanding takes time. The next fact will help clarify.

q3.title: Default Matters
q3.script: Posture you maintain without thinking is your default. Defaults accumulate. Years of slouching create chronic patterns. The position you hold most often shapes your body.
q3.prompt: What surprises you most about this?

options.text: I never thought about it this way
options.response: That shift in perspective is exactly the point. New angles reveal new truths.
That's learning in action. When understanding shifts, you're really getting it.

wisdom.title: Today's Wisdom
wisdom.script: Here's today's wisdom: How you hold yourself shapes how you feel and how others perceive you. Form affects function. Carry yourself deliberately.
wisdom.prompt: What resonates most with you today?

options.response: That central truth will stay with you. Let it guide your thinking.
Application is where knowledge becomes wisdom. That's the real learning.

outro.title: See You Tomorrow
outro.script: That's Day 311. Tomorrow, we'll explore help until help arrives—first aid basics. Until then, notice your default posture.
outro.prompt: Before you go—what will you take from today?

options.response: Reflection deepens learning. Let these ideas simmer in your mind.
Teaching others is the best way to learn. You've already begun the ripple.

growTrack.title: Posture Check - How Do You Carry Yourself?
growTrack.activity: Notice your posture right now. Are you slouching? Tense? What's your default when you're not paying attention? Stand or sit tall for one minute and notice how it feels. What would better default posture require?
